title: A term with 2,000 customers lists them all in under a second
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A} is held by exactly 2,000 customers.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-22 Bulk and the customers are ZZAUTOTEST S4-22 0001 to ZZAUTOTEST S4-22 2000 (contacts import).
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers" while watching a stopwatch.
  3. Scroll the list to the bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the full list shows in under 1 second, with "2000 selected" (or "2,000 selected").
  • Step 3: the list scrolls through every customer, ending with the last one in A to Z order; there are no page buttons and no "load more".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R13: “For a term with up to 2,000 customers, the window shows its full list in under 1 second, and the list scrolls through every customer without paging.”
  • Assumptions: “A single term can hold more than 1,500 customers (the test organization holds 1,528 on Due on Receipt and 768 vendors on COD); the Credit Terms page and the Move Customers window are sized for that.”
